company_roles: Separate SHA256 role hash modulo 3: 0 training, 1 calibration/model selection, 2 untouched final evaluation
selection: Weighted out-of-company-fold calibration log loss; Brier loss breaks ties. Final labels never choose a model or threshold.
sampling: All in-frame companies with a first recorded BRD Chapter 7/11 event in 2012-2022, and a 10 percent Bernoulli sample of the remaining frame. Inverse company inclusion probabilities apply to every snapshot, including negative snapshots of future-case companies.
target: First observed BRD Chapter 7/11 case in (prediction_date, prediction_date + one calendar year]; prior recorded cases excluded
scope: Historical nonfinancial SEC 10-K/USD issuers, complete source/BRD eligibility and financial features at most 180 days old. Not verified 2026 market coverage.
promotion: No automatic approval, source-completeness or representative-population certification. A failed gate remains failed.
